name: goateq
description: > **Get Greatest Of All Time audio quality directly in your browser.** An advanced real-time equalizer and audio enhancement toolkit rebuilt from the ground up for modern browsers.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i src/tailwind/input.css -o chromium/popup.css && cp chromium/popup.css edge/popup.css && cp chromium/popup.css firefox/popup.css
